description: B2B AI gateway that applies PII redaction, admission control, cost accounting and error policy to OpenAI, Anthropic and Google traffic without rewriting the payload.
rules: shim is a drop-in base URL, not an SDK. Keep the provider's own SDK and set base_url to the shim host plus /v1.

Authenticate to shim with SHIM_API_KEY via 'Authorization: Bearer'. Provider keys stay on the shim side (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY) or are passed per request as 'x-provider-key'. The shim key is never forwarded to a provider.
Attribute usage and cost with the 'X-Shim-Tag' header.
Request and response bodies are the provider's own. shim does not translate payloads.
Use POST /v1/scan to check text for PII without calling any provider.
Write the name in lowercase as 'shim', except in environment variables (SHIM_API_KEY) and headers (X-Shim-Tag).
